definitions.explanation: The chemical solution used to develop exposed photographic film or paper, turning the latent image into a visible one.

examples.japanese: {現像液|げんぞうえき}に{浸|ひた}す。
フィルムを{現像液|げんぞうえき}につける。
examples.english: put the film into the developer

examples.japanese: {暗室|あんしつ}で{現像液|げんぞうえき}の{温度|おんど}を{慎重|しんちょう}に{管理|かんり}する。
examples.english: carefully control the temperature of the developer in the darkroom

notes:
Composed of {現像|げんぞう} (photo developing) + {液|えき} (liquid).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現像液|げんぞうえき}に{浸|ひた}す: to immerse in developer
- {現像液|げんぞうえき}の{温度|おんど}: developer temperature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定着液|ていちゃくえき}: fixer — the solution used after the developer to stabilize the image
- {現像|げんぞう}: developing — the process itself, not the chemical
